scenes.title: The sound alone: drops fall with no food
scenes.era: Early 1900s, Physiology Department, Imperial Institute of Experimental Medicine, St. Petersburg (earliest period, experimenter still in the room counting drops)

layout.description: Bright laboratory room with tall windows. A low wooden stand (table) in the middle; above it a wooden frame with an overhead crossbar from which leather straps hold the dog's harness. The dog stands side-on to camera, head toward a wooden shelf on which the metronome ticks. An assistant sits on a stool close to the dog's cheek with a notebook; a graduated glass tube is clamped to a small stand beside the dog's head, fed by a thin tube from the cheek funnel. No food bowl anywhere in view.

positions.where: standing on the wooden stand, centre, harnessed to the overhead crossbar
positions.facing: toward the metronome on the shelf, side-on to camera

positions.where: on a stool at the dog's cheek side, camera right
positions.facing: the graduated tube and the funnel on the dog's cheek

positions.where: standing behind the assistant, slightly back

props.name: metronome
props.period_detail: wooden pyramid metronome with a swinging metal pendulum (stimulus named in Conditioned Reflexes, Lecture II)
props.physical_behavior: pendulum swings side to side and ticks steadily

props.name: glass funnel on the cheek
props.period_detail: small glass funnel cemented over the relocated duct opening on the outside of the cheek (Mendeleev cement)
props.physical_behavior: a clear bead of saliva swells at its spout and drips

props.name: graduated glass tube / cylinder
props.period_detail: thin glass tube with etched scale marks
props.physical_behavior: liquid level creeps up one mark at a time as drops fall

props.name: leather harness and straps
props.period_detail: brown leather harness hanging from an overhead wooden crossbar (blocking from archive film M1 and recreation M2)
props.physical_behavior: straps sway slightly as the dog shifts its weight

props.name: notebook and pencil
props.physical_behavior: pencil scratches tally marks

actions.verb_sequence: flicks the metronome pendulum -> sits back -> leans toward the cheek funnel -> counts drops with pencil taps -> scribbles tally marks
ears prick at the ticking -> licks its lips -> shifts weight forward in the harness while saliva drips from the cheek funnel

reactions.reaction: pencil freezes mid-tally, shoulders lift, leans closer to the tube
grips the edge of the stand and bends in, hands on knees

scenes.wardrobe: Pavlov: white laboratory coat, full white beard (portrait photographs; actor in M2 recreation). Assistant: white laboratory coat, dark trousers. Dog: matte-white porcelain dog, brown leather harness keeps its real colour.
scenes.lighting: Bright daylight from tall laboratory windows, clean and photoreal.
scenes.recognition_hook: A harnessed dog drooling into a glass tube at the sound of a ticking metronome, with no food in sight - 'Pavlov's dog'.

key_visual.description: the harnessed porcelain dog hears the ticking metronome before any food appears and saliva drips from the cheek tube into the graduated glass vial

scenes.title: Fitting the dog: cheek funnel, tube and graduated glass

layout.description: Close framing on the dog's head and shoulder on the stand. The relocated duct opening is on the outside of the cheek; a small glass funnel sits over it, a thin rubber tube runs down to a graduated glass container on the stand. An assistant's hands adjust the funnel.

positions.where: on the stand, head in frame
beside the dog's head, camera right, hands at the cheek

props.name: glass funnel
props.period_detail: small, cemented to the cheek skin over the duct opening
props.physical_behavior: first clear drop slides down its glass wall

props.name: thin rubber tube
props.physical_behavior: drop travels down inside it

props.name: graduated glass container
props.physical_behavior: first drop splashes at the bottom

actions.verb_sequence: presses the funnel rim against the cheek -> taps the glass -> pours a measured drop into the container to zero it
shakes its head once -> settles in the harness

reactions.reaction: steadies the dog with a palm on its neck, shoulders relaxed

scenes.wardrobe: Assistant in white coat; porcelain dog in brown leather harness.
scenes.lighting: Bright window daylight, macro detail on glass.
scenes.recognition_hook: The glass tube sticking out of the dog's cheek.

scenes.title: Pairing: the tick, then the food

layout.description: Medium shot: metronome on the shelf at left, dog on its stand centre, assistant at right swinging a shallow food bowl under the dog's muzzle a moment after starting the metronome.

positions.where: right of the dog, holding the bowl

props.name: metronome
props.physical_behavior: pendulum starts swinging first

props.name: shallow food bowl
props.period_detail: enamel or earthenware bowl of food (exact food not specified in the lectures read; textbooks say meat powder)
props.physical_behavior: food crumbs scatter as the dog eats

props.name: cheek funnel and tube
props.physical_behavior: saliva streams out fast

actions.verb_sequence: flicks the metronome -> waits a beat -> swings the bowl under the muzzle
lunges at the bowl -> eats -> saliva streams down the tube

reactions.reaction: pulls the bowl back, writes a number, repeats

scenes.recognition_hook: Sound first, food second - the pairing everyone learns in school.

scenes.title: The experimenter is the noise
scenes.era: Early 1900s, ordinary laboratory room before the special building

layout.description: Experimenter sits a metre from the dog in the same room trying to keep still; the dog's ears and head track his every blink, breath and shift of posture. A door at the back is half open; footsteps pass.

positions.where: on a chair facing the dog, camera right

props.name: notebook
props.period_detail: lab notebook on the experimenter's knee
props.physical_behavior: pages flutter when he shifts

props.name: graduated tube
props.physical_behavior: level jumps irregularly, spoiling the count

actions.verb_sequence: shifts on the chair -> coughs -> the dog jerks toward him -> slams the notebook shut
jerks its head toward every movement -> paces on the stand

reactions.reaction: slumps, rubs his forehead, shoulders drop

scenes.lighting: Daylight with moving window shadows (shadows were one of the listed disturbances).
scenes.recognition_hook: The scientist himself spoils the experiment.

scenes.title: Timing test: buzzer after food vs before food
scenes.era: 1900s-1920s (Krestovnikov experiments reported in the 1927 lectures; date not given)

layout.description: Same stand; an electric buzzer box mounted on the wall with a push button on a cord held by the assistant. Split staging: first the bowl then the buzz (nothing in the tube), then the buzz then the bowl (tube fills).

positions.where: beside the wall buzzer, camera left

props.name: electric buzzer
props.period_detail: wall-mounted electric buzzer / bell box with push button
props.physical_behavior: buzzes, small hammer vibrates

props.name: food bowl
props.physical_behavior: slides in

props.name: graduated tube
props.physical_behavior: stays dry in version one, fills in version two

actions.verb_sequence: presses the buzzer button with a thumb -> slides the bowl in
pricks its ears -> drools before the bowl arrives

reactions.reaction: leans back, taps the tube twice

scenes.recognition_hook: Same sound, opposite result - only the order changed.

scenes.title: The soundproof laboratory: dog alone, experimenter behind the wall
scenes.era: 1910s, special laboratory at the Institute of Experimental Medicine (exact completion year not verified)

layout.description: One research room split in two by a thick soundproof partition. Left compartment: the dog alone on its stand with funnel and tube. Right compartment: the experimenter at a small control board, squeezing a rubber bulb (pneumatic transmission) or pressing a switch that starts the stimulus, reading drops on a recorder. Blocking echo of M1 operator-at-panel frame.

positions.where: right compartment at the control board

props.name: soundproof partition
props.physical_behavior: static; camera slides across it

props.name: rubber squeeze bulb with air tube
props.physical_behavior: bulb collapses when squeezed

props.name: drop recorder / graduated tube
props.period_detail: electric drop recorder or graduated tube read from outside
props.physical_behavior: marker clicks once per drop

actions.verb_sequence: squeezes the bulb -> watches the recorder -> scribbles the count
ears prick at the sound -> licks lips -> drools alone

reactions.reaction: sits bolt upright, presses his palm flat on the desk

scenes.recognition_hook: Walls between dog and scientist - and the sound still works.

layout.description: Ceremony hall; Pavlov in formal dress receives the diploma. Longform only.

scenes.title: You and the ping

layout.description: Modern kitchen counter in daylight; a porcelain person in a hoodie sits with a mug; a phone face-down on the counter lights up and pings.

props.name: smartphone
props.physical_behavior: screen flashes, phone vibrates across the counter

props.name: coffee mug
